terms.title: Conditions d’utilisation
terms.intro: Ces conditions expliquent les règles applicables à l’utilisation de la plateforme communautaire BX-Connect.

sections.title: 1. Objet de la plateforme
sections.body: BX-Connect est une plateforme de Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL destinée à faciliter la participation des jeunes, référents, administrateurs et partenaires. Elle permet notamment de gérer des comptes, groupes, activités, inscriptions, projets, messages, notifications et soutiens partenaires.

sections.title: 2. Création et sécurité du compte
sections.body: L’inscription autonome est réservée aux personnes âgées d’au moins 16 ans. L’utilisateur fournit des informations exactes et conserve ses identifiants confidentiels. BX-Connect ne propose actuellement aucun parcours de consentement parental pour les moins de 16 ans. En cas de suspicion d’accès non autorisé, il doit contacter rapidement l’équipe BX-Connect.

sections.title: 3. Rôles et accès
sections.body: Les fonctionnalités dépendent du rôle attribué : membre, référent, administrateur, super administrateur ou partenaire. Il est interdit de tenter d’accéder aux données ou espaces d’un autre rôle, groupe ou utilisateur.

sections.body: Les contenus et échanges doivent rester respectueux, licites et liés aux objectifs de la communauté. Sont interdits : harcèlement, discrimination, usurpation d’identité, contenu illégal, atteinte à la vie privée, publicité abusive et tentative de compromettre la plateforme.

sections.title: 5. Contenus publiés
sections.body: L’utilisateur reste responsable des textes, commentaires, projets et messages qu’il publie. Il confirme disposer des droits nécessaires. BX-Connect peut masquer ou supprimer un contenu manifestement illicite, dangereux ou contraire à ces conditions.

sections.title: 6. Suspension et suppression

sections.title: 7. Disponibilité et responsabilité
sections.body: BX-Connect vise un service fiable mais ne garantit pas une disponibilité permanente. L’ASBL n’est pas responsable des interruptions raisonnables, des services tiers ou des dommages indirects, dans les limites autorisées par le droit belge.

sections.title: 8. Droit applicable et contact

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain the rules that apply when using the BX-Connect community platform.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of the platform
sections.body: BX-Connect is a Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL platform designed to support young members, mentors, administrators and partners. It manages accounts, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages, notifications and partner support.

sections.title: 2. Account creation and security
sections.body: Independent registration is reserved for people aged at least 16. Users must provide accurate information and keep their credentials confidential. BX-Connect currently provides no parental-consent process for people under 16. Suspected unauthorised access must be reported promptly.

sections.title: 3. Roles and access
sections.body: Features depend on the assigned role: member, mentor, administrator, super administrator or partner. Attempting to access another role’s, group’s or user’s restricted data is prohibited.

sections.title: 4. Expected conduct
sections.body: Content and exchanges must remain respectful, lawful and relevant to the community. Harassment, discrimination, impersonation, illegal content, privacy violations, abusive advertising and attacks against the platform are prohibited.

sections.title: 5. Published content
sections.body: Users remain responsible for the texts, comments, projects and messages they publish and confirm they hold the necessary rights. BX-Connect may hide or remove clearly unlawful, dangerous or non-compliant content.

sections.title: 6. Suspension and deletion
sections.body: An account may be limited, suspended or disabled following a breach, security risk or legitimate request. Users may request deletion, subject to information that must be retained for legal obligations or the defence of rights.

sections.title: 7. Availability and liability
sections.body: BX-Connect aims to provide a reliable service but cannot guarantee permanent availability. Within the limits of Belgian law, the association is not liable for reasonable interruptions, third-party services or indirect damage.

sections.title: 8. Applicable law and contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by Belgian law. Questions may be sent to contact@bxconnect.be. An amicable solution will be sought before legal proceedings.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how BX-Connect processes personal data in line with GDPR principles.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: Bx-Jeunes Impact ASBL, Brussels, Belgium, is the controller for processing performed through BX-Connect. Data protection contact: contact@bxconnect.be.

sections.title: 2. Data processed
sections.body: We may process identity and contact details, date of birth, role, language, registration date, group information, activities and registrations, projects and participation, messages, notifications, financial support, technical logs and evidence of legal acceptance. The full date of birth is required when creating a new account and remains private.

sections.title: 3. Purposes
sections.body: Data is used to create and secure accounts, verify the minimum age of 16, manage roles, groups, activities, registrations, projects, messages and notifications, process partner support, provide assistance and prevent abuse. Age may later be used to adapt the experience or certain activities, subject to appropriate notice.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases
sections.body: Depending on the processing, the legal basis is performance of the requested service, consent, legal obligations or the association’s legitimate interest in securing and improving the platform.

sections.title: 5. Recipients and processors
sections.body: Only authorised people can access data according to their role. Technical providers may support hosting, communications or payments under appropriate contractual safeguards.

sections.title: 6. Retention and security
sections.body: The date of birth is retained with the account for as long as needed. Data is then deleted or anonymised in accordance with applicable rules unless a legal duty applies. Access controls, authentication, logging and backups reduce risks.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have rights including access to, rectification and erasure of your data, including your date of birth, as well as restriction, objection and portability where applicable. Consent may be withdrawn without affecting earlier lawful processing.

sections.title: 8. Exercising your rights
sections.body: Send requests to contact@bxconnect.be with your identity and request. You may also complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority: www.dataprotectionauthority.be.
